adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound/clamp. Since this is a public endpoint (`/groups/:group_id/members`), a caller can request an arbitrarily large `limit` (e.g. `?limit=999999`) and force a very large membership dump/query. The change also applies pagination to all groups (not just automatic), but still lacks any server-side maximum.
